claims.text: Pilot the decision system—not autonomous taste
Three demonstrated mechanisms justify one controlled test
A generic first draft moves the expensive decision downstream
Worlds turns make it better into a visible macro decision
Value comes from commitment—not from an endless menu
A higher creative ceiling shifts more risk to the operator
Change radius—not tool preference—should route the work
Live Mode compresses a bounded compare–tune–accept loop
A wrong visual grammar requires a reference reset—not more polish
Accepted decisions matter only when they constrain the next cycle
The demo shows structured convergence—not measured optimization
A matched-task test isolates workflow value from operator enthusiasm
